pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, inverse text on dark blocks

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, primary borders, hairline rules, icon strokes, logo

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark surface blocks, inverse badges, input fields on dark

graphite.$description: Graphite — Footer borders, subtle dark dividers, secondary dark UI

suisse-intl.$description: Sole typeface across every context — navigation, body, display headlines, buttons, badges, inputs. The brand carries a single weight (400) and a single letterform language, creating typographic unity without hierarchy through weight. The tight line-heights (1.00–1.20) and negative tracking across all sizes make text feel architectural rather than comfortable.
